name: LucidFlex 50K
source: Account holder reaffirmation 2026-09-27: LucidFlex 50K DOES have a 50% consistency rule, and it applies ON TOP OF the 2-trading-day minimum. Every number here is the 2026-08 snapshot's, unchanged -- this file records the reaffirmation, not a change, so Flex results are identical under either snapshot. (A 2026-09-26 correction circulated claiming Flex had NO consistency rule; the account holder withdrew it on 2026-09-27. That claim was never adopted here.)
payout_ladder: first cheques capped $2,000, later $2,500; up to 5 payouts then live review; 90/10 split beyond
notes: Contract scaling (funded): start 20 micros, 30 at +$1,000, 40 at +$2,000; 4 minis = 40 micros is the hard cap (eval too). NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning when a ledger exceeds it.
Flat by 16:10 ET, no overnight holds. NOT enforced by the simulator — surfaced as a warning.
Only the FIRST payout is simulated; the ladder above is informational.
Trailing max loss is measured END OF DAY, not intraday: the floor moves up with EOD peak profit and never moves down.
The floor LOCKS at +$100 once EOD profit reaches +$2,100 — from then on the account cannot be trailed below +$100.

Consistency is checked at the moment of passing: largest winning day must be <= 50% of total profit, else keep trading. Reaffirmed by the account holder 2026-09-27 -- it applies ON TOP OF the 2-trading-day minimum, not instead of it.
Payout requires 5 separate days >= $150 AND net > 0. Payout amount is 50% of profit capped at $2,000, so the max payout additionally needs >= $4,000 profit.
No daily-loss limit and no calendar time limit on the eval; the sim horizon stands in for 'eventually'.
disclaimer: Illustrative, versioned snapshot — verify against LucidFlex's current rulebook before relying on these numbers.
